dialogues.speaker: Musica Instrumentalis
dialogues.text: "Calcerius said that if Dominus Boethius saw what Dominus Cassiodor's successors had done to musical instruments, he'd probably get so incensed to tear down his palace."

dialogues.speaker: Musica Instrumentalis
dialogues.text: "Vindia replied that Boethius wouldn't even have to — when she was still above ground, Cassiodor's palace in Petrocorii had already been razed by the King of Aremorica."

dialogues.speaker: Musica Instrumentalis
dialogues.text: "So I said that in that case, Boethius and the King of Aremorica must have been good friends, but my words were met only with silence."
